Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Restricted the travel destination dropdown to the Japanese datacentres available to the user: Elemental, Gaia, and Mana. The world dropdown now only shows worlds belonging to those allowed datacentres. The quick Back to Ravana button still resolves Ravana separately.
